recoverability-2: PLAN.md:63-66 (## Release and recovery) — The plan only says 'stop and report' before install. It gives no recovery path for when the installed version fails S-8/S-9/S-10 after deploy, for example Codex boot failing for users because of the `--no-daemon` default, or a wrong settings migration. The implementer has to decide how to restore the previous installed version, how to undo a migrated `--no-daemon` default (and whether the old default argv is backed up), and whether a slot left in `recovery_required` is handled by `recover` alone or by a manual procedure.
